paragraphs.text: "The darkness crawls with vampires and ghouls, but we are not without allies." —Mikaeus, the Lunarch

"What cannot be destroyed will be bound." —Oath of Avacyn
"I stand for every cobbler, tanner, and fool in this town—and they stand for me."

Survival of the purest.

The ingenuity of goblins, the depravity of demons, and the smarts of sheep.

Each morning, he repairs the front door.

Animated by geists fused in its oak, it hungers for more life to add to its core.

As if anyone needed another reason to avoid dark, dank cellars.

It comes off as easily as your own skin.

Nothing could break it but the fall.
